# Jahjah WebDigital

> Jahjah WebDigital is a Lebanon-based studio that builds restaurant websites, digital and QR menus, direct online ordering, WhatsApp ordering, add-on upselling, table ordering and reservation systems for restaurants and cafés in Lebanon, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Kuwait. It also builds business websites worldwide. Restaurants pay a fixed one-time build price — there is no commission per order.

Primary website: https://jahjahwebdigital.com/
Contact: WhatsApp +961 71 466 516 (https://wa.me/96171466516) · Instagram @jahjah.webdigital.lb
Free offer: a free restaurant demo — the restaurant sends its name and Instagram or website and receives a restaurant-specific menu/ordering direction, with no obligation: https://jahjahwebdigital.com/free-restaurant-demo

## Restaurant pricing (USD, one-time build + monthly care after launch)
- Basic — restaurant landing page: $299 + $99/month care
- Moderate — menu & ordering system (cart, options, dine-in/takeaway/delivery, WhatsApp or direct order submission): $699 + $99/month care
- Advanced — ordering system plus marketing structure and local SEO: $1,299 + $149/month care
- Extra features (second language, reservations, extra branch, loyalty, promo codes, analytics and more): $50 each
- No per-order commission.
- Business (non-restaurant) websites: $319 / $519 / $719 + $99/month care — https://jahjahwebdigital.com/packages

## Live restaurant work (built by Jahjah WebDigital, publicly accessible)
- Al Afandi Chicken — Dubai, UAE: Arabic/English ordering, five-branch selection, "complete your meal" add-on step, send-or-pay checkout, AED pricing. https://alafandichicken.com/
- Afandi Chicken — Lebanon: Arabic/English menu, delivery or takeaway, item options, family meals and combos, "order again". https://alafandi-chicken.com/
- The Sweet Spot — Tripoli, Lebanon: categorised dessert menu, featured picks, offers, online ordering for pickup or delivery. https://sweetspotlebanon.today/
- Wholesome Craft Resto Café — El Mina, Lebanon: menu, table reservations, online ordering, private events. https://wholesomecraft.life/
- Bloom Outlet — large-catalogue fashion e-commerce: https://www.bloom-outlet.com/
- Case studies: https://jahjahwebdigital.com/work
